process.title: From problem to *product*
process.intro: Five steps, each with something real behind it.

steps.name: Discover
steps.body: Understand users, business rules and constraints before drawing anything.
steps.example: SalesPoint: mapped KYC, activation and approval rules across roles and operators.

steps.name: Define
steps.body: Turn findings into a clear problem, flows and information architecture.
steps.example: Multi-stage, role-based approvals reduced to flows each role can follow.

steps.name: Design
steps.body: Wireframes to high-fidelity UI, built on the system, not around it.
steps.example: 200+ screens on shared components and tokens.

steps.name: Test
steps.body: Compare options side by side and decide with evidence.
steps.example: 12 competing variants tested: 5 activation flows, 5 credit-limit patterns, 2 migration models.

steps.name: Build / hand off
steps.body: Ship with specs, tokens and governance, or build the front end myself.
steps.example: Components reviewed and approved before they enter the library.

aboutPage.title: About
intro: I'm Hamza, a senior UI/UX and product designer in Amman, Jordan. I've spent four years making complex telecom platforms simple enough for daily, high-volume use.

I own the UX and the design system of SalesPoint, one dealer platform running across five operators. I also build what I design, in React and React Native, and use AI tools to get from concept to a near-production prototype quickly.

how.title: How I think

Make the complex simple: clear flows for KYC, activation, billing and approvals.
Decide with evidence: I compare variants side by side.
Lead through standards: design-system governance and review before components enter the library.

items.b: SalesPoint runs across five operators on one system: tokens for light/dark, Arabic/English RTL, multiple fonts and brand switching. Each new operator launched on existing components.
KYC and identity verification, SIM activation (physical and eSIM), billing, ownership transfer, dealer wallets, commission engines and multi-stage approvals, turned into clear flows for daily use.
12 competing UX variants tested side by side: 5 activation flows, 5 credit-limit patterns and 2 migration models.
9+ personal apps shipped end to end in React and React Native, with AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Figma Make, Lovable, MCP) taking concepts to near-production prototypes fast.
I run design-system governance (components are reviewed and approved before entering the library), set standards other designers build against, and coordinate design priorities across the team.
